display_long_description:
The year is 2049, and you are NATALIE RAMIREZ, a member of a mission to Mars that’s so fruitless, it’s deemed as the end of space exploration. Days before your scheduled return to Earth, you discover a reservoir of subsurface water that resurrects your mission. But when you tell your daughter you have to stay on Mars indefinitely, she goes into hiding, leaving a trail of alarming clues. With your dream and your family pulling you in opposite directions, which path will you choose?
[media]
Embark on a dangerous drilling expedition. You will drill, climb, haul, and repair Martian machinery with your own hands, all while urgent holographic calls from your family interrupt you at the worst possible moments.
Your desire to complete the mission will inevitably conflict with your need to save your daughter. Every dialogue choice is as consequential as every physical task, leading to dramatically different results.
Will you save humanity, or your own family?
[media]

FEATURES:
Full-Body Astronaut Simulation: Physically drill, climb, haul and stack massive drill parts onto your truck
Explore Mars: Ride a Camel Rover across the open Martian landscape
A Companion in the Void: Find creative ways to repair your robotic companion
Branching Cinematic Thriller: Navigate holographic family drama where every choice changes your path and ending
Built for VR Storytellers: A 120-minute, movie-like, single-player narrative experience
